summary: finalize the T035/T036 real-mainnet ingestion contracts with the measured provider facts and add the header/time ADR addendum
owner_direction:
Owner direction for the T035/T036 SPEC amendment.

1. Reference pool for T036 = PoolId 0x6c614c38c65fea492f4cb2b90fd664f924a7b828c7384620662217e2e2df43ed, PoolKey currency0 0x5fc5360d0400a0fd4f2af552add042d716f1d168 (USDG, 6 decimals), currency1 0x7dbf38976f6d3b9c529e7d9484a71898b409ee6a (ZZZ, 18 decimals), fee 28001, tickSpacing 280, hooks 0x0. Robinhood Chain mainnet chainId 4663, PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951, StateView 0xf3334192d15450cdd385c8b70e03f9a6bd9e673b.

2. Reference range for T036 = blocks 54946237..55946237 inclusive.

3. Measured facts to carry into the T035/T036 contract bodies and into the provider-facts artifact (measured 2026-09-17 against the public mainnet endpoint, latest block 65392511): (a) that single range is covered by ONE eth_getLogs call with the [[5 topic0s], poolId] filter and returned 3739 events across 3266 distinct blocks (Initialize 1, ModifyLiquidity 578, Swap 3159, ProtocolFeeUpdated 1, Donate 0); (b) the eth_getLogs blockTimestamp field is 0x0 on every observed log, so block time must come from eth_getBlockByNumber; (c) a 5-topic0 OR over the full chain range times out with -32000 log query timed out; (d) a single-event full-range query fails with -32000 logs matched by query exceeds limit of 10000; (e) rapid sequential calls produce HTTP 429; (f) the second qualified endpoint accepts about 10 blocks per eth_getLogs call, so it cannot carry the main scan and participates only in sampled cross-validation; (g) both qualified endpoints support JSON-RPC batching of eth_getBlockByNumber; (h) the primary endpoint cannot serve historical state via eth_call at that depth while the second endpoint can, so the block-pinned StateView read must be issued to an endpoint able to serve historical state and the runbook must say so.

4. Contract points to make explicit in T035 and T036: (a) the acquisition shape is fixed - one pool-filtered range query per planned sub-range, events persisted with their (block_number, transaction_index, log_index) position, state rebuilt locally downstream; never one eth_getLogs call per block, never one eth_getBlockByNumber call per scanned block, never a header for a block with no pool event, and no eth_call during acquisition; (b) header logical calls are deduplicated per distinct event block and issued as JSON-RPC batches, with the logical-call versus HTTP-batch split reported; (c) the header record keyed by (chain_id, block_hash) carrying block_number, parent_hash and timestamp, the Parquet columns block_timestamp and parent_hash, and the manifest header table are all required together, not as alternatives; (d) T036's independent fidelity check is a sampled cross-endpoint comparison within the second endpoint's measured capability covering the start, middle and end of the range, and a window the second endpoint cannot serve is reported as blocked, never skipped and never replaced by re-reading the first endpoint.

5. Add a new ADR addendum under docs/spec/architecture/adr/ recording the header/time persistence location and the acquisition call-volume principle above. Do not reopen ADR-002 or ADR-010; the addendum refines them.

6. Raise spec_revision.

7. Keep the T030 through T034 contract text untouched. T035 and T036 close and reference their unimplemented clauses instead of rewriting them.
